name: Encrypted Scroll
summary: In Deathknell, an Encrypted Scroll calls a newly risen rogue to training. Sealed by David Trias, it directs its bearer to meet him at the inn and begin training among the Forsaken’s covert operatives.

sections.title: A Covert Summons
sections.body: In Deathknell, a newly awakened Forsaken with a gift for stealth draws notice. The Encrypted Scroll is handed over after a scout proves capable against the mindless Scourge in the nearby graveyard. Sealed by rogue trainer David Trias, it tells the bearer to find him at the local inn. The summons points a fledgling operative toward the discipline needed to serve the Dark Lady, rather than spend a second chance at life as a pickpocket.

sections.title: Eyes of the Shadowstalkers
sections.body: The scroll’s brief message tells the rogue to make contact in Deathknell before traveling deeper into Tirisfal Glades. Trias watches for promising talent on behalf of the Shadowstalkers, the Forsaken’s covert arm. In Lordaeron, the Forsaken rely on silent blades and cunning scouts against the Scarlet Crusade, surviving Alliance enclaves, and the Scourge left behind. Answering the ciphered summons begins the path toward joining that covert network.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Scroll?
faq.answer: The Encrypted Scroll summons a newly risen Forsaken rogue to David Trias at the Deathknell inn to begin rogue training.
The Encrypted Scroll bears the personal seal of David Trias, the rogue trainer in Deathknell who watches for promising recruits.

faq.q: What are the Shadowstalkers mentioned by David Trias?
faq.answer: The Shadowstalkers are a covert Forsaken group of rogues, scouts, and assassins operating across Lordaeron. David Trias assesses new talent for their ranks.

faq.q: Where do I take the Encrypted Scroll after reading it?
aliases: who do i bring scroll to
faq.answer: Take the Encrypted Scroll to David Trias at the inn in Deathknell.

angles.text: As a rogue, you begin your instruction in stealth, lockpicking, and dirty fighting under the Forsaken rogue cadre’s watch.
As one of the newly risen in Deathknell, you have an early chance to find a purposeful role in Sylvanas’s emerging kingdom.
